scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check on the status of my application. Can you help me with that?
dialogue.agent: I can help with that. I see your application is for a loan amount of $205,000 with a term of 360 months. Your loan was purchased by Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Can you tell me if my application was approved or denied? And if it was approved, what is the interest rate on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your application was approved. The interest rate on your loan is 3.5%.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for letting me know. Do you know if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: That's good to hear. Lastly, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Yes, your loan was purchased by Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user: Thank you for all the information. I feel well-informed about my loan status and details. <Satisfied> The agent was clear, provided all the necessary details, and was polite throughout the conversation.
